title: Stationary virtual heads when halted
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let a vector of payload reads, one for each work tape and one for the virtual input, be given. If the selected state is absent, every virtual head direction is stationary.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite machine over Booleans
A payload-read vector with one entry per work tape and one for the virtual input
replaced:
For every binary machine $M$ and every vector of payload reads, each of the $k+1$
virtual head directions selected in the halted state is stationary.
